email.invitation.subject: You are invited to {org} on Code-Ox Vision
email.invitation.body:
Hello,

{inviter} invited you to join {org} on Code-Ox Vision as {role}.

Accept the invitation and choose your password here (the link works for 7 days):
{link}

If you did not expect this email you can ignore it.

Code-Ox Vision
email.reset.subject: Reset your Code-Ox Vision password
email.reset.body:
Hello,

Someone asked to reset the password for this email address on Code-Ox Vision.

Choose a new password here (the link works for 1 hour):
{link}

If it was not you, ignore this email; your password stays the same.

Code-Ox Vision
